formal_definition_frame_review.native_map_storage: Line/plane/cylinder coefficient maps and NURBS knots have formal native parameter axes. The record ID/domain and evaluator frame binding are authoritative; no Length/Ratio unit is inferred for arbitrary native coordinates. Directions/orthonormal axes and rational weights are dimensionless mathematical quantities. UV components may have different or unresolved parameter units.

formal_definition_frame_review.scene_boundary: Preview section coordinates are scene observation coordinates. Raw meshes may have coordinate_units=None; no metres may be fabricated. Physical analysis conversion requires independently resolved scale.

numeric_ledger_recommendations.action: Retain narrow numerical-kernel dispositions already documented in boundary-reviews.md, tied to actual typed caller operators/layouts. Do not classify other structs in same directory by path alone.
